coach_says: Your TSB of -41.5 is deep in the red, so despite a strong readiness score this week is about absorbing fitness, not adding load. Tuesday's committed double (hills AM + MTB group ride PM) is your one and only quality day — the hill tempo work also covers your aerobic-high shortage — and everything else is easy or rest, with total volume cut roughly in half. Watch morning HRV and legs on Thursday/Friday; if HRV drops or the Friday ride feels laboured, shorten it and take Saturday fully off.

days.details: 45 min restorative/yin yoga indoors — rain and 44 km/h winds rule out riding anyway. Focus: hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine, deep breathing. Goal is parasympathetic recovery and fresh legs for tomorrow's double day. No strength holds, no flow that raises heart rate.

days.session: AM hills tempo + PM hard MTB group ride (double day)
days.details: AM (road, ~60 min) | Primary objective: tempo/threshold hills to address aerobic-high shortage | Zone 3 to low Zone 4. Warm-up 15 min Z2 building. Main set: 3 x 8 min climbing at Z3-low Z4 (RPE 7), seated, controlled breathing, recover fully on descents (~5 min easy). Cool-down 10 min Z1. PM (~90 min): committed hard MTB group ride — go with the group, but given TSB -41.5 avoid contesting every sprint; ride strong on the sustained sections and sit in where you can. Fuel well between sessions (carbs at lunch, 60g/hr carbs on the evening ride).

Lunch swim, strictly recovery pace. Warmup: 200m easy freestyle, focus on long exhale. Main set: 4 x 100m easy (odd lengths drill — catch-up or fingertip drag — even lengths smooth swim), 20s rest; then 200m pull with buoy, relaxed. Cooldown: 200m very easy mixed strokes. Total: 1000m. Effort RPE 3 throughout — this flushes Tuesday's legs, nothing more.

days.session: Workout A — posterior chain & stability (reduced load)
days.details: Lunch gym, 45 min. Warm-up: 8 min — bike erg easy, glute bridges 2x10, band walks 2x10/side. Main: Romanian Deadlift 3x8 (moderate load, ~65-70% of usual, crisp form), Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8/leg (bodyweight or light DBs), Single-Leg Glute Bridge 3x10/leg, Pallof Press 3x10/side, Side Plank 3x30s/side. Rest 90s between sets. Objective: maintain posterior chain and hip stability without adding fatigue — loads deliberately reduced given TSB -41.5 and tomorrow's endurance ride. No heavy quad-dominant work.

Total 2 hrs | Primary objective: steady aerobic endurance | Zone 2 (RPE 4-5, conversational). Last good weather day before the weekend turns wet — get outdoors. Flat to rolling route, high cadence 90+ rpm, stay strictly in Z2 even on rises (shift down, don't push). No intervals. Fuel with 40-60g carbs/hr. If legs feel heavy or HRV dipped this morning, cap it at 90 min — this week is recovery-first.

Active recovery only. Option A: 60 min easy walk/hike if the drizzle holds off. Option B: 45-60 min recovery yoga flow indoors if it's properly wet. Keep heart rate low, no structured effort. Purpose is circulation and movement quality while the deep fatigue clears.

Complete rest — rain forecast makes this an easy call and your TSB demands it. Prioritise 8+ hrs sleep, good food, hydration. Optional 15 min gentle stretching in the evening. Arriving at next week fresher will let us rebuild quality work on a stronger base.
